associations.claim_evidence: Croatian bishops identify the Our Lady of Refuge sanctuary as a Marian pilgrim destination near the Danube.
associations.qualification: No route or continuing schedule inferred from historical index.

associations.claim_evidence: Croatian bishops' index dates designation of the national Saint Joseph sanctuary to 1987.
associations.qualification: National shrine title applies to designated Karlovac site, not to generic Saint Joseph dedications.

associations.claim_evidence: The sanctuary records a novena of nine Wednesdays before the March feast of St Joseph.
associations.qualification: Regional practice noted historically; recurrence and calendar dates require current custodian.

associations.claim_evidence: Croatian bishops describe longstanding pilgrimages to Our Lady of Krasno.
associations.qualification: No claim that current visitor totals match historical description.

associations.claim_evidence: The Croatian bishops index describes annual pilgrimages to the Precious Blood Eucharistic sanctuary at Ludbreg.
associations.qualification: Apparition or forensic miracle authentication is NOT inferred from name/title.

associations.claim_evidence: The sanctuary has a historical Precious Blood devotional tradition distinct from Marian images and ordinary saint relics.
associations.qualification: Do not classify a Eucharistic phenomenon as a Marian apparition or relic object without separate evidence.

associations.claim_evidence: The Croatian bishops include the Remete shrine in Zagreb among pilgrim destinations.
associations.qualification: Ancient reported miracles and destroyed documents are historical claims, not certified by the app.

associations.claim_evidence: Franciscan custodian documents pilgrimage and liturgical celebrations of Our Lady of Sinj for August 2026.
associations.qualification: 2026 programme is historical, not a 2027 or continuing schedule.

associations.claim_evidence: The Sinj Marian sanctuary documented a 15 August 2026 procession in town.
associations.qualification: Local Croatian practice, not assumed French domestic tradition.

associations.claim_evidence: Croatian bishops describe the Marian painting and votive crown associated with Sinj.
associations.qualification: Historical rescue narrative and claims of miracles require separate editorial treatment.

associations.claim_evidence: Gospa od Otoka pilgrimage church at Solin identified by bishops as Croatian Marian sanctuary.
associations.qualification: Reproduction of ancient Marian artwork must not be described as original icon at this site.

associations.claim_evidence: Croatian bishops document Trsat as a Marian pilgrimage site connected to Loreto tradition.
associations.qualification: Tradition of miraculous translation of Holy House is not independently historical proof.

associations.claim_evidence: Custodial historical church account describes an image of Our Lady associated with Trsat.
associations.qualification: Not a claim that the Holy House remains physically at Trsat.

associations.claim_evidence: Bishops' record names the Jerusalem Mother of God pilgrimage church and locally celebrated votive feast days.
associations.qualification: Local Croatian proštenja, no French-cultural universalization.

associations.claim_evidence: The Marian Vepric sanctuary was founded in 1908 commemorating Lourdes apparitions.
associations.qualification: A Lourdes dedication outside France does not create a new apparition case.

associations.claim_evidence: Bishops document Voćin pilgrimage processions from Požega and surrounding towns.
associations.qualification: Historical route narrative not sufficient for precise polyline.

associations.claim_evidence: Pilgrims gather for votive candlelight observances in Voćin.

review_rules: Do not automatically publish individual sites in a map; a church and its embedded chapel/grotto may share a physical building but remain distinct canonical subsite identities.
Croatian Bishops' Conference historic index names sites; contemporary ownership, dates, addresses and exact coordinates require later checks.
The Rotterdam Diocese explicitly classifies these as diocesan pilgrimage locations, NOT ten nationally designated shrines.
Some historical ruins (e.g. Saint Hallvard, Øm Abbey) differ from current Catholic-owned places; do not mislabel current confession.
Sweden's Blåkyrkan historical church is not the Catholic Pax Mariae convent; preserve ownership distinction.
Church of Sant'Antimo in San Marino has relics of St Agatha reportedly held there, while the Basilica holds founder Marinus relics; do not combine objects.
Mellieħa St Luke authorship is traditional legend, not a certified historical painting provenance.
Dates and programmes in 2025 and 2026 sources are not future schedules.
No geographic pins, biographies, source-media reuse or copyright-unlicensed images from this research file.
